calc.description: annex_a_v0_2_calc_v11 15-minute mint (annex_a_v0_2_calc_v11), effective 2026-08-30T23:07:28Z; METHODOLOGY.md is the binding methodology document. Two changes from annex_a_v0_2_calc_v7, both read field-by-field off the published corpus records' calc_params (COM-1455). CADENCE: the observation grid adds a 15-minute era from 2026-08-28 (slot_minutes_utc, 96 marks); every era before it keeps its own marks and its own published bytes, and the lane is minute-keyed from this mint on. SIGMA FLOOR: the absolute 0.05 USD/GPU-hr floor becomes the percent pair of the 2026-08-27 floor split -- filter_sigma_floor_pct 3% fences outliers, vote_sigma_floor_pct 3% floors the median-vote band, and the vote sigma is sourced from the trailing dynamic-weights history (vote_sigma_source dw_history) rather than the 20-print outlier window. Every other parameter the published projection carries -- membership and opening weights, liveness knobs, tier allow-list, filter window/sigma/warm-up/terms, manual-verify percent, FX lane, manual exclusions, claim floor -- is unchanged and was verified identical to the live record.
